table2_splits.caption: Benchmark split schemes (full profile): mean records per fold and the share of test records whose event or station also occurs in training.
table2_splits.note: Seen event / seen station are reported, not failed, except where the scheme groups by that key.

table3_accuracy.caption: Test RMSE (ln units) by model and split scheme (full profile), averaged over folds and 27 intensity measures.
table3_accuracy.note: Classical models use the train_fit bias term (ergodic mode). (site) = the same model with train_fit station terms added (zero for stations unseen in train_fit), i.e. with the same site information as the machine-learning models. Lowest value per scheme in bold.

table4_conformal_ablation.caption: Empirical coverage and mean interval width (ln units, in parentheses) by uncertainty method and split scheme (full profile), averaged over 8 models, folds and 27 intensity measures.

table5_conditional_coverage.caption: Conditional coverage at nominal 90% by magnitude, rupture distance, VS30 class and station status (full profile), pooled over schemes, models and folds.
table5_conditional_coverage.note: Seen = station recorded in train_fit or cal.

tableS1_per_im_metrics.caption: Per-IM test RMSE (ln units; one column per model) and calibrated-band coverage and width at 90% (Event split, full profile).
tableS1_per_im_metrics.note: Abbreviations: ME = Mixed effects; XGB = XGBoost; Hyb-A = Hybrid ASK14+MLP; Hyb-B = Hybrid BSSA14+XGB.

tableS2_sp23_comparison.caption: Profile comparison: full versus sp23 (the Sedaghati and Pezeshk 2023 selection) and test RMSE under the Event split.
tableS2_sp23_comparison.note: Published counts are reference values from the cited study; all other values are computed here.

rows.Item: Sedaghati and Pezeshk (2023): records / events / stations

tableS3_bootstrap_cis.caption: Event-clustered bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (full profile; 1,000 replicates resampling whole earthquakes within each split scheme): estimate [lower, upper].
tableS3_bootstrap_cis.note: Estimates are the Table 3 and Table 4 statistics recomputed from per-earthquake sums; each replicate draws earthquakes with replacement and keeps all of their records and intensity measures together, and both models of a difference use the same draw. Earthquakes per scheme: Event 575, Station 575, Region 548, Temporal 157, Mw >= 7 20, CL1 to CL2 148.

tableS4_station_rmse.caption: Test RMSE (ln units) at stations seen and unseen in train_fit (full profile), for models that use station information: estimate [event-clustered bootstrap 95% interval].
tableS4_station_rmse.note: (site) = NGA-West2 model plus train_fit station terms; the hybrids encode stations from train_fit only. Both therefore have the same site information, and unseen stations receive no station term in either. RMSE is averaged over folds and intensity measures as in Table 3.
